class.name: ReloadedMaterialServer
class.description: A track's rails and bed and a mesh's surfaces take their materials by the name the data gives them. The core knows no material data: a plugin provides them ([method material_set_provider]); without one nothing is found, and whatever asks draws with its own default.

method.name: material_get
method.description: The material of [param name], null when there is none or no provider. [param options]: [code]cull_disabled[/code] (bool) - it draws both faces.

method.name: material_get_texture_length
method.description: The length the material's texture covers along a track [lb]m[rb], -1 when the material declares none.

method.name: material_get_texture_size
method.description: The size of the material's texture in texels, zero when unknown.

method.name: material_set_provider
method.description: What finds the materials: [code]material(name, options) -> Material[/code], [code]texture_size(name) -> Vector2i[/code], [code]texture_length(name) -> float[/code].
